turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail: ottle doesn’t require a special setup. For your first use: - Fill it with a cold, non-carbonated drink. - Secure the Yonder™ Cap, which is 100% leakproof. - Avoid hot or carbonated beverages, food, or perishables. - When you’re finished, place the bottle and cap in the dishwasher. The bottle can go on the dishwasher’s top rack, and the gasket should go in the utensils basket. Hand washing is also fine. The bottle is non-insulated, so it may develop condensation and won’t keep drinks hot or cold.
